Supercar repair in Shah Alam

A supercar workshop for the Klang Valley, with the cars on our own lifts.

Service and software

We have serviced a Lamborghini Aventador SVJ, done a car service and software reset on a Ferrari Purosangue, and repaired the turbo on a Ferrari 488 GTB.

Suspension and interior parts

Air suspension, air balloon and electric absorber work on Rolls-Royce cars, and gear knob panel repairs on the Ferrari 488 and BMW M4.

Makes

Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Porsche and Rolls-Royce, alongside BMW, Mercedes-Benz, Audi, Volvo and Land Rover.

Questions

Which supercars do you work on?

Lamborghini, Ferrari, McLaren, Porsche and Rolls-Royce. Our posts include the Aventador SVJ, Urus, Ferrari 488 GTB, Purosangue and Rolls-Royce Cullinan and Ghost.

Can you reset supercar software?

Yes. We did a car service and software reset on a Ferrari Purosangue. WhatsApp us your model and what you need.
